messages:
rachel (sales): Zenith POC is blocked by JSON parse failures when using function calls + json_mode. They hit it during a bulk sync.
zenith-lia (customer): example output: ```{"updates": [{"key": "u1", "status": "ok"}]}
Summary: last batch had 2 failures```
omar (solutions): can you include the request id and whether you streamed the response? also SDK version?
zenith-lia (customer): req=zn_55f, stream=true, sdk=2.0. we also saw intermittent 429s. logs show: ```2024-08-02T09:14:12Z WARN req zn_55f 429 qps=38 limit=35
2024-08-02T09:14:13Z INFO partial zn_55f "{\"updates\": [...] } Some note"```
vinh (eng-runtime): streaming + json_mode + rate-limited flush = common culprit. runtime can trim non-json trailing tokens or enforce strict json headers to reject responses with suffixes.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout: runtime v1.0.3 at 2024-08-02T02:00 UTC.
omar (solutions): short-term plan: 1) enable header `X-Redwood-JSON-Mode: strict` 2) set route option `truncate_trailing_text=true` 3) if 429s persist request temporary QPS bump.
clare (security): Zenith requires 12mo log retention and no plaintext request bodies in hosted logs. if we do a short-term bump, we need written confirmation on log redaction.
rachel (sales): looping legal & sales-ops.
zenith-lia (customer): applied strict + truncate locally: parse success ~97%, still ~3% truncated when 429s hit. new id zn_55g sent.
vinh (eng-runtime): send zn_55g logs. if truncation persists we'll enable `atomic_response=true` on their route and add server-side validator that returns 502 if response not valid JSON. also recommend client-side: on parse failure and http 200, do one immediate retry with small backoff.
omar (solutions): I'll draft a one-pager: headers, retry snippet, and two pricing options: short QPS bump (2 weeks) vs Dedicated eval.
rachel (sales): thanks — Zenith, expect pricing & legal follow-up today. :thumbsup:
